reference_facts.statement: XBOX Wire reports that toggle hold is coming to the Xbox Elite Wireless Controller Series 2 and Xbox Adaptive Controller, with an accessibility use for players who may need alternatives to simultaneous button presses.
When enabled, toggle hold lets one controller button remain held after a single press.
Disability Arts Online announces dis_place, a planned digital gallery intended to reduce access barriers and platform disabled, D/deaf and neurodivergent artists.
The soft launch partnership with MIMA was scheduled to reimagine selected Towards New Worlds works for online audiences from May to December 2025.
Australian Museum reports that Unfinished Business opened and shares first-person experiences of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people with disability.
The exhibition presents stories from 30 people and was created by Belinda Mason with Dieter and Liam Knierim in collaboration with the First Peoples Disability Network.
